issue_request: FHIR-19458 is a Published/Persuasive FM change request raised in STU3 and applied for R5 asking to add Patient and RelatedPerson to Claim.enterer for non-provider-filled claims.
initial_application: Git commit acb64eec3ca82f9a8d18d4091f2416029ee45dcd explicitly mentions FHIR-19458 and added Patient and RelatedPerson target profiles to source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini. The same application commit handled the same enterer expansion for ExplanationOfBenefit in FHIR-37863. Later same-file history did not remove the requested Claim.enterer targets. Exact Zulip and Confluence issue-key searches found no conflicting community record; a broader RelatedPerson Zulip discussion listed Claim.enterer as a Practitioner-only gap.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml already permits Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Patient, and RelatedPerson for Claim.enterer.
